blockingFindings.finding: Arbitrary --report paths can overwrite formal artifacts after the unchanged snapshot and still exit zero.
Formal artifact snapshots omit the complete .electron-app and release trees required by the frozen architecture.
Windows case aliases in perFileLineMinimum can pass validation while silently disabling the floor.
Unified runner accepts child JSON by state only, does not validate report schemas, and early setup failures can leave stale successful reports.
Coverage self-proof does not inject a passing-ratio failing child or a passing-ratio formal-artifact mutation; stale proof uses invalid JSON and is not coupled to a forced miss.
Coverage failure precedence and timeout handling do not match the frozen contract; timeout may produce no authority report.
Self-test forced coverage can overwrite the preserved normal coverage evidence.
Packaged E2E folds the original NSIS NTSTATUS into TEST_ASSERTION and does not preserve phase-specific installer evidence.
Partial-install cleanup swallows uninstaller failures and does not fail closed on uninstall registry, shortcut, process and install-directory residue.
--task is not propagated into coverage governance, blocking the intended extension path for later task manifests.

requiredBeforeRerun: Constrain and validate report destinations before execution and publication.
Snapshot the complete formal artifact set or update the frozen architecture with an independently approved equivalent.
Validate and publish strict current-run report schemas; remove stale reports before work begins.
Add real coverage child-failure, artifact-mutation, valid-stale and preserved-output isolation proofs.
Preserve installer phase, raw exit code and cleanup evidence; make partial-install cleanup fail closed.
Generate a new Build ID and installer because tests and gate scripts are source-digest inputs.
